"The strike was in response to IRGC aggression targeting U.S. personnel and assets," CBS News quoted the official as saying, referring to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. Israeli parliament elects new speaker opposed to Netanyahu Israel's parliament elected a new speaker opposed to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Tuesday night, giving Netanyahu's opponents control over the legislative agenda as talks to form a new government continued. Matan Kahana, a lawmaker with Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party, defeated Ofir Katz of Netanyahu's Likud party by 66 votes to 52, replacing Netanyahu ally Amir Ohana. Live broadcast from the chamber showed lawmakers from the anti-Netanyahu bloc breaking into applause, hugging and shaking hands after the vote. items.title: Dollar holds near 19-month high as data supports case for US rate hikes By Reuters
items.excerpt: TOKYO, Nov 18 (Reuters) - The dollar held steady near a 19-month high on Wednesday as US economic data and comments from Federal Reserve officials lent support to the case for interest rate hikes. The yen held its ground after Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated the need to tighten policy further. The Australian dollar fell to a 10-month low ahead of a key jobs report on Thursday. Data on Tuesday showed US retail sales increased moderately in October, reinforcing expectations for a rate hike next month. Attention turns to US housing starts data due later on Wednesday as well as a series of Fed speakers, all ahead of the Thursday release of minutes of the central bank’s meeting last month, when it held rates steady. "Overall, the report reinforces our view that further interest rate hikes from the Fed are warranted in order to counter demand-pull inflation," Henry Russell, a London-based economist for ANZ, said about the US sales data. "The strength of domestic demand in the US, in our view, warrants a decisive monetary policy response from the Fed." The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, rose 0.06% to 103.67. It touched 103.78 overnight, its highest level since April 2, 2025. The euro was down 0.14% at $1.0982, while the yen edged up 0.08% to 159.25 per dollar. Sterling lost 0.13% to $1.3191. In addition to a 0.2% rise in retail sales that matched expectations, import prices climbed 1.1% in October compared with expectations for a 0.7% increase. More US data is expected with the Census Bureau due to report housing starts data for October. Analysts are projecting an increase to 1.245 million from 1.221 million in September, while building permits likely decreased. New York Fed President John Williams is expected to speak again following comments on Tuesday when he said the Fed will likely need to raise interest rates further to contend with inflation. Fed Board Governor Michael Barr and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari are also expected to speak at separate events. Traders are pricing in a 95.7% chance that the Fed will raise its key rate by 25 basis points (bps) in December, the CME FedWatch tool showed. The odds of a 50-bp increase have fallen to 4.3%, from 13.5% a month ago.

items.title: World News Live Updates: Trump heads to China amid US tech outages for ‘first-ever’ Xi-Putin talks, seeks to project strength | World News - The Indian Express
items.excerpt: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping met for the 50th time on Wednesday on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in China’s Shenzhen, with the Chinese leader saying that ties between China and Russia would “bring more stability and certainty to a turbulent, chaotic world.” Addressing Putin, he said, “My old friend, it’s symbolic that this is our 50th personal meeting.” US President Donald Trump is expected to arrive in China later in the day ahead of an unprecedented trilateral meeting with the two leaders on Thursday, November 19. Trump, Xi and Putin will hold a first-ever trilateral meeting on Thursday November 19 on the APEC forum, according to the BBC. China confirmed the meeting on Monday, following announcements by the White House and Kremlin. Trump is seeking to project American strength amid a series of technology outages at home involving Microsoft, the Federal Aviation Administration, JPMorgan Chase and the National Security Agency during the talks, AP reported. While Trump dismissed the disruptions, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was “zero” evidence linking them to foreign rivals, hackers or criminals. The trilateral meeting is expected to cover nuclear arms control, the Ukraine war and the conflict involving Iran, though analysts do not expect major breakthroughs. Trump also expressed willingness to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, but no meeting has been scheduled. Trade, artificial intelligence and China’s access to advanced computer chips are also expected to feature in discussions. Trump is scheduled to attend the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Thursday before meeting Xi and Putin.

items.excerpt: Raye and Rosalia lead nominations for music's Grammy Awards British singer Raye, the artist behind the genre-mixing hit that asks "Where Is My Husband!," landed at the top of the list of Grammy Award nominees on Monday, ahead of Spanish musician Rosalia and "Choosin' Texas" artist Ella Langley. Raye earned 11 Grammy nominations including nods for song and record of the year for "Husband," and for album of the ‌year for "This Music May Contain Hope." Rosalia racked up nine nominations, days after she dominated the Latin Grammys with her album "Lux." ... British actor Robert Pattinson named as new James Bond British actor Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond, Amazon MGM Studios announced on Monday, taking on one of cinema's most coveted roles. The Bond franchise — about a British secret agent known for his charm, his tailored tuxedos and a fondness for martinis "shaken, not stirred" — is among the longest-running and highest-grossing in Hollywood history. ... Hollywood salutes Glenn ... Hollywood's big-screen stars celebrated the careers ⁠of actor Glenn Close and director Ridley Scott on Sunday at the annual Governors Awards, one of the first red-carpet events of the movie awards season. The pair were among five film industry heavyweights bestowed with honorary Oscars at a gala attended by A-list actors from Tom Cruise to power couple Zendaya and Tom Holland.

items.title: Rushes | Pattinson Plays Bond, Brand Enters Prison, Zoomers Revive Cinemagoing on Notebook | MUBI
items.excerpt: - Robert Pattinson has been cast as the latest James Bond. He marks the eighth actor who has played the character onscreen, and he will bring him to life in the first Bond film produced by Amazon MGM, set to be directed by Denis Villeneuve. - Palestinian surgeon Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira, who was featured in Poh Si Teng’s American Doctor (2026), was killed in an Israeli air strike. The documentary, which premiered at this year’s Sundance Film Festival, chronicles three American physicians providing medical aid in Gaza. “This is yet another devastating example of the continued violence against Gaza’s medical community. Hospitals are places of healing, not targets of war,” said Hamza Ali, co-founder of Watermelon Pictures, the film’s North American distributor. - London judge Joel Bennathan has sentenced English comedian Russell Brand to ten-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assaults. Bennathan described Brand as a “sexual predator” who believed “fame meant you could act how you liked, when you liked, unhindered by the rules by which decent people live.” - President Trump is reportedly working on bipartisan legislation to boost the US film industry by providing a twenty-percent tax incentive to production companies looking to shoot within the country.

items.title: YouTube Creator Premieres: New Entertainment Slate - YouTube Blog
items.excerpt: In 1929, the very first Academy Awards were held in the Blossom Room of the Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel. Tonight, in that exact same room, the next era of entertainment took the stage with our annual YouTube Creator Premiere. Hosted by House Guest’s Scott Evans, the showcase offered sneak peeks, first-looks, and major programming announcements from the visionary storytellers shaping the future of the platform—including Emma Chamberlain, Aryna Sabalenka, Nick DiGiovanni, Wesley Wang, and Grace Reiter —proving that the most exciting, must-watch content is happening on YouTube.

items.title: AP Entertainment SummaryBrief at 1:02 a.m. EST | Features | rutlandherald.com
items.excerpt: The 2026 Country Music Association Awards are here with Taylor Swift performing: How to watch NEW YORK (AP) — The 2026 Country Music Association Awards are here. Taylor Swift will perform at the award show for the first time in 13 years. Ella Langley leads the nominations with nine. She is followed by Miranda Lambert with seven. Langley, Cody Johnson, Chris Stapleton, Luke Combs and Lainey Wilson are competing for the top prize, entertainer of the year. Brooks & Dunn will receive the Willie Nelson Lifetime Achievement Award. The ceremony will feature tributes to Dolly Parton and performances by top country artists. Wilson will once again host. The event airs Nov. 18 on ABC and Disney+ and will be available to stream the next day on Hulu.
